voice.name: Open Sector - Blackbird
voice.description: Male reconnaissance test pilot in his late thirties speaking through a pressure-suit helmet microphone, calm laconic and unflappable, quiet low voice with a dry flat American drawl, slightly muffled and close to the mic, cool professional detachment, sounds like he is far above everything and in no hurry.
voice.sample: Recon, eighty thousand feet, Mach three. Cameras are running. Nothing up here but me and the curve of the earth. You can't touch me from down there, so don't bother trying.

ready: Blackbird fueled and ready. Cameras loaded.

move.prompt: Jet reconnaissance plane taking off with afterburners lit, deep roaring turbojet engines building to a thundering blast as it accelerates down the runway and climbs steeply away, close, outdoors, no music, no voice

die.prompt: Jet airplane shot down, engines flaming out with a high whine, screaming steep descent and violent crash with explosion and tearing metal, outdoors, no music, no voice
